_howto: The game's WHAT'S NEW: the title screen's message of the day (motd) and the changelog, newest first. Player-facing only.
motd: Version 1.9.0: give your POKéMON held items, from LEFTOVERS to the CHOICE SCARF!

changelog.title: Held items
changes: Your POKéMON can hold items now. Use ITEM > GIVE or TAKE on the party screen, or pick a held item in the BAG
The MART's new HELD ITEMS counter sells the SITRUS BERRY, LEFTOVERS and FOCUS SASH from 2 badges, and the LIFE ORB and CHOICE SCARF from 4
The CHOICE SCARF now really raises SPEED by half, for trainers' POKéMON too. A FOCUS SASH or SITRUS BERRY is used up once it works
EGGS in your party have an EGG picture
The BATTLE MOVES page no longer runs a move's type into its PP
Version numbers now have three parts: new regions, new features, then fixes

changelog.title: Eggs in the party
changes: The EGGS you carry show in the party screen's free slots, with a bar that fills as each one nears hatching and the steps it has left. With a full party, the message says when the next one hatches
Using a REPEL while one is still working no longer uses it up

changelog.title: Stones, TMs and the Day Care
changes: Evolution stones (FIRE, WATER, THUNDER, LEAF, MOON, SUN, SHINY, DUSK, DAWN and ICE), sold at the MART's new EVOLUTION counter once you have 3 badges. EEVEE, CLAMPERL and the others that never evolved now can

Trade evolutions use the LINKING CORD, from the same counter, alongside the OVAL STONE, RAZOR CLAW and RAZOR FANG. POKéMON whose evolution needed something this game doesn't have now evolve at a level
TMs: the MART's TMs counter sells 73 of them, with stronger moves unlocking as you earn badges. A TM never runs out
The MOVE TUTOR in every POKéMON CENTER teaches back any move your POKéMON could have learned by its level
REPEL, SUPER REPEL, MAX REPEL and the ESCAPE ROPE, in every MART
The GOOD ROD (3 badges) and SUPER ROD (6 badges), from the FISHERMAN who gave you the OLD ROD: fewer misses, higher levels and rarer catches
Trainer rematches: route trainers will battle again once a day (every 30 minutes of play), with their full team at your level
The DAY CARE in CINDERGATE TOWN raises up to two POKéMON as you walk. Two that get along may leave an EGG, which hatches into a level 1 POKéMON
The MAX POTION, in the MART from 6 badges
Using an item that only works outside battle now says so instead of doing nothing

changelog.title: Crash Fixes
changes: Fixed a crash when walking from an area with weather (rain, fog, snow or a cave) into a bigger town, such as ROUTE 3 into TIDALKEEP CITY or ROUTE 5 into WISPGATE CITY

Fixed a crash when opening a PC box holding many different POKéMON. Icons in the PC and the party now share their colours, so a shiny's icon shows its normal colours (it's still shiny in battle and on its summary)

changelog.title: The Master Ball
changes: The MASTER BALL: the best ball there is. It catches any wild POKéMON without fail
At the Sunken Shrine, WREN now hands you a MASTER BALL before you face the guardian

changelog.title: Trades, the Safari Zone and Hidden Items
changes: TRADEWIND VILLAGE: south of WISPGATE CITY, open once you beat its Gym Leader. Its TRADER swaps one of your POKéMON for a random one of about the same level
The SAFARI ZONE, north of PORTMERE HARBOUR: $5000 to enter, and every POKéMON, legendaries included, is as likely to appear as any other
Hidden items: watch for a glint on the ground, then face the spot and press A. RARE CANDIES and better POKé BALLS are waiting along the way
New items: GREAT BALL (1.5x catch rate) and ULTRA BALL (2x) in the POKé MART from your 2nd and 5th badges, and the RARE CANDY, which raises a POKéMON by one level

changelog.title: Fast Travel and Faster Days
changes: Open the POKéNAV map and pick any town or route you've been to, then press A to travel there
Towns drop you at the POKéMON CENTER door; routes put you on the path where you'd enter them
Days go by faster: morning, day, evening and night now last 7.5 minutes of play each, so a full day is 30 minutes

changelog.title: PP, Stat Moves and Weather
changes: Every move has PP. A POKéMON CENTER refills it; a Pokémon with no PP left will Struggle
New moves to learn: stat boosters like SWORDS DANCE and CALM MIND, stat drops like GROWL and LEER, healing like RECOVER, and SUNNY DAY, RAIN DANCE, SANDSTORM and HAIL
ABSORB and GIGA DRAIN heal the user, DOUBLE-EDGE has recoil, and EARTHQUAKE or ROCK SLIDE hit every foe
FIGHT now asks for a target first. Moves are coloured for it: red super effective, yellow a normal hit, grey no effect. B goes back to change the target

changelog.title: Shiny Pokémon and Spirecrest Town
changes: Shiny Pokémon: 1 in 4096, twice as often in ADVENTURE MODE and 1.25 times in a NUZLOCKE run. They sparkle when they appear
The CHALLENGE TOWER now stands in its own town, SPIRECREST, south of DUSKMERE HOLLOW. It opens once you're CHAMPION
Five themed floors, a SUMMONING STONE at the top, and a chamber themed for the legendary it calls

changelog.title: Nuzlocke and Adventure Mode
changes: NUZLOCKE mode at NEW GAME: fainted Pokémon are gone, one catch per area, level caps, and a GRAVEYARD in the PC
SKIP STORY TEXT for faster replays
After the credits, ADVENTURE MODE and the CHALLENGE TOWER, with legendaries to catch at the top

changelog.title: Party Royale on the Game Boy Advance
changes: The whole adventure, from the professor's welcome to the Hall of Fame
Every move animated in battle, and catching with each Pokémon's real catch rate
